decision: Use Layered Memory Engine with Confidence Classification
reason: Distinguish Known facts from Assumed vs Unknown hypotheses

decision: Scope working/session/project memory to the bound project
reason: One Core governs many repositories. A single global project.json accumulated every repo's stack facts, so an agent could read another project's frameworks as though they described the current one. Discovered when init seeded scratch-project facts into the real Core store.
alternatives: Project key field on each fact with reader-side filtering
Registry of per-project files under CoreSentinel/memory/projects/
Leave global and document the limitation
chosen: Project-scoped layers resolve to <project>/.coresentinel/memory via upward .coresentinel/config.json discovery, falling back to the Core store when unbound
